name: TOI-1117
description: Star of 5,635 K, 168 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

text.card: TOI-1117 b crosses TOI-1117 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Lockley et al. 2025.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname LOCKLEY_ET_AL_2025): st_teff 5635, st_rad 1.05, st_mass 0.97

quotes.title: TOI-1117
quotes.card: TOI-1117 is a single G-type star in the constellation of Pavo.
quotes.introduction: It has approximately 0.97 times the mass and 1.05 times the radius of the Sun, with a surface temperature of 5,635±62 K and a spectral type of G7.

notes: TOI-1117 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
